registration: Internal versioned plan written after training-period exploration, not external preregistration or live prediction
training: All predictor refits use June-July only; fixed-random labels regenerated; compatible unchanged swarm refits retained

swarm.unique_compilations: At most 56; duplicates use within-search cache

random_fixed_56.selection: Identity plus 55 seeded unique random injective placements; no companion swarm required

resource_interpretation: Equal proposal budgets; NOT equal actual unique compilations or wall time
triggers: Fixed trained drift threshold; ridge/forest predicted delta TVD >1e-10; periodic elapsed days from own last compile >=3/7
model_updates: No retraining or online updates during validation/test trajectories; flag out-of-training-range inputs without overriding decisions

validation.analysis: Report known-template temporal transfer and new-family/time transfer separately; do not pool them as a single generalization claim

final_test.selection: One evaluation of frozen policy choices; no selection or tuning from final-test results

embargo: First four dates of August and September omitted before outcome generation so 72-hour-valid initial calibration measurements follow the preceding period. Verify actual source-key disjointness, not just nominal dates.
circuit_source: Original frozen generator/QASM; no new angles or benchmark selection based on held-out outcomes
calibration_policy: Original six-property quality and <=72h observation/measurement age rules, latest observed event; no imputation/fallback to older healthy measurements
state_and_gaps: Compile once at first ready date; each policy retains own native circuit; skip blocked days and reset all policies together next ready date; separate common initialization calls
noise: Unchanged exact density-matrix depolarizing + asymmetric assignment; no hardware evidence
metric_limits: Output-distribution TVD is not quantum state/process fidelity. QFT of a computational-basis input has uniform ideal output probabilities and can be insensitive to phase errors; report this limitation for the QFT robustness block rather than inferring gate-fidelity generalization.
primary_quality: Equal-current-date mean output-distribution TVD on all ready days; also report paired daily differences, pooled/trajectory summaries and per-template strata
primary_work: Number of actual native placement compilations charged to the policy, including common initializations; also report triggered recompile calls and native circuit changes
timing: Exploratory separately measured searches/controller overhead, with shared-library accounting disclosed; no conversion between seconds and TVD
allowance_interpretation: Predeclared sensitivity grid for observed mean error, not a claim that a loss is acceptable to the user or a statistical noninferiority margin
selection_rule: Separately for each compiler and allowance, on known-template August validation only, retain policies whose equal-date mean TVD minus always <= allowance +1e-10. Choose minimum total native placement compilations, then lower TVD, then fewer triggered recompiles, then policy name. Freeze these choices before final-test generation. Always is feasible fallback.
unseen_family_validation_role: Descriptive robustness check only; cannot choose settings using QFT outcomes
reporting: Publish all seven predeclared policies and all four allowances, including failures; label any selected-policy test results by the allowance that selected them
no_significance_shortcut: Dates/circuits/seeds are correlated. Report paired date-level and seed variability without pretending each row is an independent trial; observed threshold satisfaction is not a statistical guarantee
required_gates: Fixed-budget labels and model replay validated
No final-test outcomes used for choices
prior_experiments: Preserved unchanged. Old random_matched results remain useful as offline equal-unique-work comparisons, but are not relabeled as fixed-budget results
